Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU endorses Global Electrification Pledge at COP31
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Union has endorsed the 35-by-35 Global Electrification Pledge at the UN Climate Change Conference COP31 in Antalya, Türkiye.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Extension of CBAM to Iceland and Norway
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: CBAM will be extended to Norway and Iceland following the entry into force of the EEA Joint Committee Decision. As of 1 January 2027, CBAM will apply in Norway and Iceland to goods imported into their customs territories, in the same way that it applies to goods entering the EU customs territory.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission invites public to shape new carbon storage certification for buildings
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission has launched a public consultation on a new methodology to certify biogenic carbon storage in buildings, closing 10 December 2026.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: OceanEye International Alliance gets bigger at COP31
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The OceanEye International Alliance for the Global Ocean Observing System (GOOS) gained further international support at COP31, with new countries and organisations joining the initiative and announcing commitments to strengthen global ocean observation.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Albuquerque hosts high-level events to champion financial literacy across the EU
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, Commissioner Maria Luís Albuquerque hosts the first of two events to raise awareness of the importance of financial literacy and empowering citizens to make sound financial decisions that will ultimately improve their well-being, financial security, and independence.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: From tomorrow until Monday, Commissioner for Energy and Housing Dan Jørgensen will be in Warsaw and Gdańsk, Poland, to discuss with Polish decision makers and stakeholders about two key priorities for European citizens: affordable, secure and clean energy, and access to affordable housing.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Marine Weather Intelligence: Bringing ocean racing knowledge to commercial shipping

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves €9.5 billion Dutch State aid to support offshore wind energy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €9.5 billion Dutch scheme to support renewable electricity production from two offshore wind farms in the North Sea.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: 17 new projects, €119 million in action for restoring and protecting Europe’s ocean and waters
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU Mission Ocean and Waters has welcomed 17 new projects selected under the eight topics of the 2025 call ‘Supporting the implementation of the Restore our Ocean and Waters Mission’ (HORIZON-MISS-2025-03).

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Autumn 2026 Economic Forecast: continued growth amid higher inflation
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Autumn 2026 Economic Forecast shows that the EU economy held up better than expected in the first three quarters of 2026. It is set to keep expanding, despite stronger and more persistent inflationary pressures and tighter financing conditions.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission adopts measures to restrict lead gunshot to protect health and the environment
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 16 November 2026, the European Commission adopted new rules to better protect human health and the environment by restricting lead gunshot under the EU’s chemicals legislation, REACH.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU advances Syrian recovery and reconstruction through Syria Partnership Coordination Forum in Damascus
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the Syria Partnership Coordination Forum (SPCF) convened in Damascus for the first time to advance Syria's recovery and reconstruction, showcase investment opportunities and agree on concrete steps forward.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission approves amended German State aid schemes for energy-intensive companies
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, Germany's amended schemes to compensate energy-intensive companies for indirect emission costs under the EU Emission Trading System (EU ETS) and for temporary electricity price relief under the CISAF and METSAF.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Seventh meeting of the Digital Markets Act High-Level Group
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the High-Level Group for the Digital Markets Act (High-Level Group) convened for its seventh Plenary meeting in Brussels.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission has approved, under EU State aid rules, a €9.5 billion Dutch scheme to support renewable electricity production from two offshore wind farms in the North Sea.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU welcomes the outcome of this year’s 45th North-East Atlantic Fisheries Commission (NEAFC) annual meeting. During this year’s negotiations, positive cooperation with like-minded partners led to concrete results on important issues for the EU.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: In focus: Industrial carbon management – how it works and why we need it
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Industrial carbon management is not a replacement for clean energy technologies. Rather, it offers solutions complementary to their rollout, and needed for the EU to become the world’s first climate-neutral continent by 2050.
